name: outlook-mcp
description: Connects your LLM to the Outlook setup. Read and write emails, contacts, and calendar events.

download_directory.title: Download Directory
download_directory.description: Directory path where email attachments and files will be downloaded. Leave empty to use system temp directory.

allowed_write_directories.title: Allowed Write Directories
allowed_write_directories.description: Comma-separated directories that save tools may write into when given an explicit destination (e.g. an expenses folder). Grants permission only — default downloads still go to the Download Directory.

shared_mailbox.title: Shared Mailbox
shared_mailbox.description: Default mailbox for the per-call 'mailbox' argument; empty = own mailbox.

known_mailboxes.title: Known Shared Mailboxes
known_mailboxes.description: Comma-separated shared mailboxes your team uses (e.g. careers@yourcompany.com, info@yourcompany.com). Used by outlook_list_shared_mailboxes for discovery.
